                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      व्यंजक = 25 / 64

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      उत्तर:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      व्यंजक का मान 25/64 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n146:T1403,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      According to Apollonius's Theorem, the sum of the squares of any two sides of a triangle equals twice the sum of the square of the median to the third side and the square of half the third side.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      In ΔPQR, PT is the median to QR, which means T is the midpoint of QR.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ PQ2 + PR2 = 2 × (PT2 + QT2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      This is a standard direct theorem identity and requires no further calculation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      &there4", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Trigonometry"], "concept": "Trigonometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6716033b42447c6aac2bc014", "qs_no": 12, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Find the gain percentage, given that Anubha sold her scooter for ₹23358 gaining \\(\\frac{1}{6}\\)th of the selling price.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "25%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "35%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "20%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "30%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "अनुभा ने अपना स्कूटर ₹23358 में बेचकर विक्रय मूल्य का \\(\\frac{1}{6}\\)वाँ भाग लाभ के रूप में अर्जित किया है। लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "25%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "35%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "20%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "30%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When profit is given as a fraction of Selling Price (SP), the actual SP value (₹23358) is not needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given Gain = 1/6 of SP.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Let SP = 6 units, then Gain = 1 unit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Cost Price (CP) = SP − Gain = 6 − 1 = 5 units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Gain % = (Gain ÷ CP) × 100 = (1 ÷ 5) × 100 = 20%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 20%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Selling Price (SP) = ₹23358

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Gain = 1/6 of SP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Gain = SP − CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Gain % = (Gain ÷ CP) × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Gain = (1 ÷ 6) × 23358 = ₹3893

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ CP = SP − Gain

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ CP = 23358 − 3893 = ₹19465

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Gain % = (3893 ÷ 19465) × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ Gain % = (1 ÷ 5) × 100 = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ The correct answer is 20%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Profit/Loss on Selling Price

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sometimes profit or loss is stated as a percentage of the Selling Price, but actual profit/loss percentage must always be calculated on the Cost Price (CP). True Profit % = Profit ÷ (SP − Profit) × 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Marked Price & Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). Equivalent discount of two successive discounts d1% and d2% is given by (d1 + d2 − d1×d2÷100)%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Dishonest Dealer

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If a trader sells goods at cost price but uses a false weight, the Profit % = (True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight × 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n12b:T7", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अनुभा ने अपनी स्कूटर ₹23,358 में बेचकर विक्रय मूल्य का 1/6 लाभ प्राप्त किया है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      लाभ प्रतिशत इस सूत्र द्वारा दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      लाभ प्रतिशत = (लाभ / क्रय मूल्य) × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      मान लीजिए क्रय मूल्य 'C' है। हम जानते हैं कि लाभ, विक्रय मूल्य का 1/6 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      लाभ = (1/6) × 23,358 = ₹3,893

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अब, विक्रय मूल्य, क्रय मूल्य और लाभ का योग है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      23,358 = C + 3,893

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ C = 23,358 - 3,893

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ C = ₹19,465

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अब, हम लाभ प्रतिशत की गणना कर सकते हैं:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      लाभ प्रतिशत = (3,893 / 19,465) × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ लाभ प्रतिशत = 0.20 × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ लाभ प्रतिशत = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      उत्तर:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      लाभ प्रतिशत 20% है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n12c:Td79,\n\n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. POQR
