                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 8√3 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Lateral Surface Area

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The lateral surface area includes only the 4 side faces of the cube, excluding the top and bottom faces. Formula: LSA = 4a2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Volume of a Cube

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The volume represents the total three-dimensional space enclosed by the cube. Formula: Volume = a3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Main Diagonal of a Cube

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The longest straight line segment that can be drawn inside a cube connecting two opposite corners. Formula: Main Diagonal = a√3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Face Diagonal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The diagonal line extending across any single flat, square face of the cube. Formula: Face Diagonal = a√2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        एक बंद घन का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 1152 सेमी² है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        एक घन का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (TSA) इस प्रकार दिया जाता है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TSA = 6 × a²

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        जहाँ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a = घन की एक भुजा की लंबाई

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        चरण-दर-चरण गणनाएँ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        हमें दिया गया है कि कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (TSA) 1152 सेमी² है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        6 × a² = 1152

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दोनों पक्षों को 6 से विभाजित करने पर:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a² = 1152 / 6 = 192

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        अब, 192 को पूर्ण वर्गों के गुणनफल के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        192 = 64 × 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        इसलिए, a² = 64 × 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दोनों पक्षों का वर्गमूल लेने पर:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a = √(64 × 3) = √64 × √3 = 8√3 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        उत्तर:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        घन की प्रत्येक भुजा की लंबाई 8√3 सेमी है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n13a:Teb5,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is Tarang Sanchar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tarang Sanchar Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          By using the value substitution method from the standard angle values:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let θ = 45°, then tan 45° = 1 and cot 45° = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Substitute the values in the equation: tan θ + cot θ = 1 + 1 = 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          This strictly satisfies the given condition, hence θ = 45°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 45°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          tan θ + cot θ = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          cot θ = 1 / tan θ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ tan θ + 1 / tan θ = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (tan2 θ + 1) / tan θ = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ tan2 θ + 1 = 2 tan θ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ tan2 θ − 2 tan θ + 1 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (tan θ − 1)2 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ tan θ − 1 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ tan θ = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ tan θ = tan 45°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ θ = 45°

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 45°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          tan θ = 1 / cot θ, sin θ = 1 / csc θ, and cos θ = 1 / sec θ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Pythagorean Identities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sin2 θ + cos2 θ = 1, sec2 θ − tan2 θ = 1, and csc2 θ − cot2 θ = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Standard Angle Values

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          tan 30° = 1 / √3, tan 45° = 1, and tan 60° = √3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          tan θ + cot θ = 2, और θ एक न्यून कोण है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          हम जानते हैं कि:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          cot θ = 1 / tan θ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          इस प्रकार, दिया गया समीकरण बन जाता है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          tan θ + 1 / tan θ = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          माना x = tan θ है। इसलिए, समीकरण बन जाता है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          x + 1 / x = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          भिन्न को समाप्त करने के लिए दोनों पक्षों को x से गुणा कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          x² + 1 = 2x Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Using the Tangent-Secant Theorem: Tangent2 = External part × Total secant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 212 = 14 × (14 + BC)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 441 = 14 × (14 + BC)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 14 + BC = 31.5 ⇒ BC = 17.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 17.5 units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Length of the tangent from point A (AT) = 21 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Length of the external secant segment (AB) = 14 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let the length of the internal secant segment (BC) be x units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Radius of the circle = 14 units (Not required for this calculation)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Tangent-Secant Theorem: AT2 = AB × AC

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The total length of the secant segment from point A is AC.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ AC = AB + BC

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ AC = 14 + x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Applying the Tangent-Secant theorem:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 212 = 14 × (14 + x)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 441 = 14 × (14 + x)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 14 + x = 441 ÷ 14

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 14 + x = 31.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 31.5 − 14

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 17.5 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 17.5 units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Tangent-Secant Theorem

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If a tangent and a secant are drawn to a circle from an exterior point, the square of the tangent is equal to the product of the external secant segment and the total secant length: AT2 = AB × AC.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Intersecting Secants Theorem

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If two secants are drawn to a circle from one exterior point, the product of the external segment and the total length of each secant are equal: AB × AC = AD × AE.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Intersecting Chords Theorem

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          When two chords intersect inside a circle, the product of the segments of one chord equals the product of the segments of the other chord: AE × EC = BE × ED.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          वृत्त की त्रिज्या = 7 इकाई

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          बिंदु A से स्पर्शरेखा की लंबाई = 21 इकाई

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          AT² = AB × AC

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
