What is the average score of the class?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "63.6"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "65.6"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "66.6"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "64.6"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "30 विद्यार्थियों की एक कक्षा एक परीक्षा देती है। 12 विद्यार्थियों का औसत स्कोर 62 है और शेष विद्यार्थियों का औसत स्कोर 68 है। कक्षा का औसत स्कोर कितना है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "63.6"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "65.6"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "66.6"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "64.6"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "30 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਜਮਾਤ ਨੇ ਇੱਕ ਟੈਸਟ ਦਿੱਤਾ। 12 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ 62 ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਕੀਆਂ ਦਾ 68 ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਹੈ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "63.6"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "65.6"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "66.6"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "64.6"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ratio of number of students in the two groups = 12 : 18 = 2 : 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let the assumed base average of the class be 62.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Deviation of the second group = 68 − 62 = +6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Average increase for the whole class = (3 × 6) ÷ (2 + 3) = 18 ÷ 5 = +3.6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Overall Average = 62 + 3.6 = 65.6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 65.6 marks.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Total number of students = 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Average score of 12 students (A1) = 62

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Average score of remaining 18 students (A2) = 68

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nदिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          कुल 30 छात्र हैं। 12 छात्रों का औसत स्कोर 62 है, और शेष 18 छात्रों का औसत स्कोर 68 है। हमें पूरी कक्षा का औसत स्कोर ज्ञात करना है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          पहले समूह के 12 छात्रों का कुल स्कोर की गणना कीजिए

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          62 के औसत स्कोर वाले 12 छात्रों का कुल स्कोर है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          पहले समूह का कुल स्कोर = 12 × 62 = 744

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          चरण 2: शेष 18 छात्रों के कुल स्कोर की गणना कीजिए

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          68 के औसत स्कोर वाले 18 छात्रों का कुल स्कोर है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दूसरे समूह का कुल स्कोर = 18 × 68 = 1224

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          च", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਕੁੱਲ 30 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਹਨ। 12 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ 62 ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਬਾਕੀ 18 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ 68 ਹੈ। ਸਾਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ ਲੱਭਣ ਲਈ ਕਿਹਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਦੇ 12 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          62 ਦੇ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ ਵਾਲੇ 12 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ = 12 x 62 = 744

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਬਾਕੀ 18 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          68 ਦੇ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ ਵਾਲੇ 18 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਦੂਜੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ = 18 x 68 = 1224

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਸਾਰੇ 30 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਸਾਰੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ = 744 + 1224 = 1968

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਪੂਰੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ = ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ / ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਕੁੱਲ ਸੰਖਿਆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ = 1968 / 30 = 65.6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਔਸਤ ਸਕੋਰ 65.6 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Chaos.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Chaos" means a state of utter confusion and disorder. (अव्यवस्था)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The sudden blackout during the event caused chaos among the audience.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It is used to describe situations where no order or organization is present, often leading to panic or disturbance. (अराजकता)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The marketplace was in chaos after the unexpected announcement of a curfew.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Chaos.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Pathos (भावुकता): A quality in art or literature that evokes pity or sadness.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The movie was filled with pathos, leaving the audience in tears.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Engross (डुबाना): To occupy the attention or focus of someone completely.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She was so engrossed in her book that she didn’t notice the time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Innuendos (इशारे): Indirect or subtle references, often implying something derogatory.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The politician’s speech was filled with innuendos about his opponent.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the active voice, the sentence is: \"Meenakshi could have sent a reply.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To convert to passive voice: Place the object \"a reply\" at the beginning.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Change the active verb form \"could have sent\" to \"could have been sent\" (perfect modal passive).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Add the preposition \"by\" followed by the original subject \"Meenakshi.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Sentence: \"A reply could have been sent by Meenakshi.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 1: \"A reply could have be sent by Meenakshi.\" – Incorrect verb form (should be \"been\" instead of \"be\").
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 3: \"A reply could have sent by Meenakshi.\" – Incorrect structure (missing \"been\").
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: \"A reply could have been send by Meenakshi.\" – Incorrect verb form (should be \"sent\" instead of \"send\").
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nLack of interest, enthusiasm or concern", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Sympathy"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Apathy"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Empathy"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Antipathy"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 2 - Apathy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Apathy refers to a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern. (उदासीनता)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The student's apathy toward the project was evident from his lack of participation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word perfectly fits the description of someone indifferent or unconcerned about situations or events.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Hence, the correct answer is: Option 2 - Apathy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Sympathy (सहानुभूति): Feelings of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She expressed her sympathy for the grieving family.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Empathy (सहानुभूति): The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: His empathy for his friend's struggles made him a great confidant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Antipathy (घृणा): A deep-seated feeling of dislike or aversion.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: Her antipathy toward loud music was well-known.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
