                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nBeseech", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Pamper"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Implore"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Impart"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Bequeath"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Implore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word \"beseech\" means to ask someone urgently and fervently to do or give something; implore; entreat. (विनती करना)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: He beseeched the judge to show mercy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \"Implore\" refers to making a serious or emotional request to someone; to beg earnestly. (मिनती करना)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She implored him to stay with her.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of 'beseech' is 'implore'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Implore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Pamper (लाड़ प्यार करना): To treat with excessive care and attention.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She pampered her dog with gourmet meals and luxurious bedding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Impart (प्रदान करना): To make information known; communicate.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The teacher imparted wisdom to her students.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Bequeath (वसीयत करना): To leave something to a person through a will.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: He bequeathed his entire estate to his children.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "good" means having the required qualities, or of a high standard. (अच्छा)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She is a good person who always helps others.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Well" refers to performing an action in a good or satisfactory way. It is the adverb form used to describe how an action is performed. (अच्छी तरह)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She sings well in the choir.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, we can infer that the correct word to use in the sentence is 'well' instead of 'good'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. well.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Better (बेहतर): Comparative form of good, meaning of a higher standard or quality.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Archaeology refers to the study of ancient things such as art, graves, ruins, and artifacts to understand past civilizations. (प्राचीन वस्तुओं का अध्ययन)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: Archaeologists discovered an ancient city buried beneath the desert sands.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The term originates from the Greek words "archaios" (ancient) and "logos" (study). It involves excavating and analyzing physical remains to reconstruct historical contexts.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The Great Pyramids of Egypt are a significant focus of archaeological research. (मिस्र के महान पिरामिड पुरातत्व अध्ययन का एक महत्वपूर्ण केंद्र हैं।)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 - Archaeology.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Astrology (ज्योतिष): The study of the movements and relative positions of celestial bodies as a means of predicting human affairs and natural phenomena.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She consulted an astrologer to learn about her future. (उसने अपने भविष्य के बारे में जानने के लिए एक ज्योतिषी से परामर्श किया।)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Geology (भूविज्ञान): The scientific study of the Earth's physical structure, substances, history, and processes.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The geologist examined the rock layers to determine the area's history.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nA continuing unpleasant situation, created when one problem causes another problem that then makes the first problem worse", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Vicious cycle"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Round cycle"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Repetitive cycle"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Enclosed cycle"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Vicious cycle.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The term "Vicious cycle" refers to a continuing unpleasant situation, created when one problem causes another problem that then makes the first problem worse. (दुष्चक्र)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: Poverty can lead to poor health, which prevents people from working and earning money, thus perpetuating the vicious cycle of poverty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Vicious cycle" is a process in which a negative event causes another negative event, reinforcing the original problem. (दुष्चक्र)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The company's poor performance led to low employee morale, which in turn led to even poorer performance, creating a vicious cycle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Vicious cycle.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Round cycle (गोल चक्र): This term does not specifically refer to a situation where problems cause other problems.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The gears in the machine follow a round cycle to complete their function.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Repetitive cycle (दोहराने वाला चक्र): This indicates a cycle that repeats but doesn't necessarily involve worsening problems.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The repetitive cycle of daily routines can sometimes feel monotonous.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Enclosed cycle (बंद चक्र): This term suggests a cycle that is closed or self-contained but does not imply a worsening situation.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: An enclosed cycle in a chemical process ensures that no materials are lost.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n103:Tcc1,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Sovereign.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n\nMiraculous", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Draining"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Average"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Expected"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Incredible"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Incredible.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "Miraculous" means something that is extraordinary and brings wonderful results, often in a way that cannot be explained by natural or scientific laws. (चमत्कारी)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The doctors said it was miraculous that she survived the accident without any injuries.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Incredible" refers to something so extraordinary or amazing that it is hard to believe. (अविश्वसनीय)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible, beyond words to describe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for 'Miraculous' is 'Incredible'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Incredible.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Draining (थकाऊ): Causing someone to lose energy or become very tired.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The long hours of work can be very draining.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Average (औसत): Typical or normal; not exceptional.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: His performance in the test was average, not outstanding but not poor either.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Expected (अपेक्षित): Regarded as likely to happen; anticipated.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The results were expected, given the amount of preparation he had done.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
