                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nThe school will hire new teachers.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "New teachers will join the school."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "The school will be hiring new teachers."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "New teachers are hired by the school."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "New teachers will be hired by the school."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the active voice, the sentence is: "The school will hire new teachers."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "new teachers" at the beginning.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Change the active verb form "will hire" to "will be hired" (future simple passive).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the school."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Sentence: "New teachers will be hired by the school."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 1: "New teachers will join the school." – This is in active voice and changes the verb.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 2: "The school will be hiring new teachers." – This is in active voice and uses the continuous form.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 3: "New teachers are hired by the school." – This is present tense, not future tense.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nAbsolve", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Commend"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Accuse"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Excuse"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Appeal"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Accuse.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "Absolve" means to free someone from guilt, blame, or responsibility. (दोषमुक्त करना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The court absolved him of all charges.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Accuse" means to charge someone with an offense or crime. (आरोप लगाना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She was accused of stealing the money.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'Absolve' is 'Accuse'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Accuse.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Commend (प्रशंसा करना): To praise someone formally or officially.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The teacher commended the student for her excellent project.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Excuse (माफ़ करना): To forgive someone for something they have done.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: Please excuse my lateness; I was caught in traffic.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Appeal (अपील करना): To make a serious or urgent request.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: He decided to appeal the court's decision.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n117:Tb90,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Splendid.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nA person who has supreme power or authority", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Secular"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Sovereign"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Diversity"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Foreign"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Sovereign.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "Sovereign" refers to a person who holds supreme power or authority, especially in a political or governmental context. (सर्वशक्तिमान)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The king was considered the sovereign ruler of the entire kingdom.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Sovereign" means a person who is supreme in power, often in a monarchy or ruling state. (सर्वशक्तिमान)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The sovereign of the country made important decisions for the people.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Therefore, the correct answer is: Sovereign.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Secular (धार्मिक तटस्थ): Relating to worldly matters rather than religious ones.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: India is a secular country with many different religions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Diversity (विविधता): The state of being diverse; variety in culture, opinion, or people.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The city is known for its cultural diversity, with people from many countries living there.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Foreign (विदेशी): Relating to or originating in a country other than one's own.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She loves to travel to foreign countries and experience new cultures.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nAppreciate", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Depict"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Acknowledge"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Esteem"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Depreciate"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Depreciate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word \"Appreciate\" means to recognize the full worth of something or to be grateful for something. (सराहना करना)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She took a moment to appreciate the beauty of the sunset.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \"Depreciate\" refers to the reduction in the value of an asset over time, or to belittle someone or something. (मूल्यह्रास करना)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: As soon as you drive a new car off the lot, it begins to depreciate in value.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'Appreciate' is 'Depreciate'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Depreciate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Depict (चित्रण करना): To represent by a drawing, painting, or other art form.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The mural depicts scenes from the city's history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Acknowledge (स्वीकार करना): To accept or admit the existence or truth of something.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: He acknowledged his mistakes and promised to improve.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Esteem (सम्मान): Respect and admiration, typically for a person.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n115:Ta8d,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 4.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The phrase "able to drink" is incorrect in this context. The correct form is "not allowed to drink," as "able" implies physical capability, whereas the sentence intends to convey prohibition. (अनुमति नहीं है)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: You are not allowed to enter without a ticket.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "allowed" should be used here to indicate that someone is prohibited or restricted from doing something. (स्वीकृत नहीं है)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She is not allowed to stay out late.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Therefore, the correct sentence is: "In some countries, you are not allowed to drink until you are 21."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 (able to drink).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In some countries, (कुछ देशों में,) This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: In some countries, it is customary to remove shoes before entering a home.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • you are not (आप नहीं हैं) This part is also grammatically correct.\n\t
